design_philosophy: Tactical Minimalism & Emergency Command Center. High density, pure data clarity, true-dark base with high-contrast semantic indicators. A hybrid SaaS app with real-time simulation feel, not a generic admin dashboard.

rules: Do not use generic fonts like Inter, Roboto, or Space Grotesk.
Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for large stats and headers.
Overlines and labels must be uppercase, tiny, wide spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).
Terminal feed must use JetBrains Mono or similar authentic monospace data font.
Body text should be highly legible, avoiding overly thin weights in dark mode.
Use Tinted Grey rule: no pure #000000 or #808080. Base is a near-black slate/blue-gray to reduce glare in long sessions.
Semantic colors dictate action and urgency; keep decorative color usage to an absolute minimum.
CRITICAL: Do not use Teal Green or Teal Blue (#1B93A4) for dashboards.

layouts.global_header: Glassmorphism header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-slate-950/70) with MedFlow branding, live pulse indicator, quick stats, and global actions. Ensure nav links remain readable.
layouts.dispatcher_console: High Density 3-column grid (grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6). Col 1: Intake Form. Col 2: Live Terminal Feed. Col 3: Holding Queue/Recent Dispatches.
layouts.hospital_capacity_network: Bento Grid Protocol Mode B (High Density Grid). 5 hospital cards displaying demographics, capacity, equipment, specialists. Tight gap spacing.
layouts.patient_footprint: 2-column layout. Left: Patient Demographics & History. Right: Medication Ledger with CRUD operations.
layouts.analytics: Dense grid containing 5 Recharts components. Use subtle grid borders (border-border/40) for structure to enforce the 'Technical' look.

visual_enhancers.terminal_feed: Retro-Futurism style terminal. Deep black background (#000000), neon semantic monospaced text, staggered entrance animations.
visual_enhancers.cards: Grid Borders ('Technical' Look). Flat background, 1px subtle border, no shadow. Hover: slight lift, border color darkens/illuminates slightly.
visual_enhancers.live_indicator: Pulsing animation using a colored dot (usually green or red based on network status) in the global header.

components.intake_form: Shadcn Form. Must include medical history capture (medications, conditions). Integrate Leaflet map with OpenStreetMap tiles for incident location.
components.terminal_feed: Custom component with overflow-y-auto, auto-scroll to bottom, Framer Motion for line-by-line staggered entry.
components.medication_ledger: Shadcn Table for CRUD. Badges for drug interaction warnings.
components.toast_notifications: Use Sonner for dispatches, queue events, and simulation resets.
components.charts: Recharts with dark-mode optimized styling (translucent fills, thin bright lines, restrained or hidden gridlines).
components.badges: Sharp edges or subtle roundness (max 4px radius). Use solid or outlined variations to indicate status.

rules: Subtle pulse for live network indicator.
Micro-interactions on hover for all interactive elements (buttons, cards).
Toast slide-ins for critical dispatch and queue events.
Minimum 4.5:1 contrast for normal text and 3:1 for large text (WCAG AA).
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute.
Focus states must have higher contrast.

instructions_to_main_agent: Share the guideline for .js files not for .tsx files.
Implement Leaflet map with OpenStreetMap tiles for the incident map in the intake form.
Integrate patient medical history (medications + conditions) into the new trauma case intake form.
Build the animated terminal-style dispatch feed with a monospaced font.
Create the 5 Recharts as requested (Crime vs Equipment, Pregnancy vs Equipment, Senior Ratio vs Waiting Area, Bed Utilization, Dispatch Distance).
Use Shadcn components for complex interactions but style them to match the tactical dark theme.
CRITICAL: Do not use complete transparent background in headers, overlays, or dropdowns. Always use glassmorphism or solid backgrounds.
Ensure the Holding Queue auto-redispatches on discharge.
Provide testing attributes for all actionable UI elements (e.g., data-testid='submit-intake').
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all) as it breaks transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e. do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc. for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use `sonner` for toasts located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.js (or relevant file).
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
